sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 387)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio and syndication, Jean Shepherd delivering his famous broadcast on Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.'s March on Washington address on WOR New York (1963–1964), George V. Denny Jr. moderating *America's Town Meeting of the Air* on the Cold War and Korean War mobilization (1946–1950), and Royal Canadian Mounted Police wilderness serial *Blair of the Mounties* (1935–1964):
